title: Member Handbook — Your Pharmacy Copay
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit copay rule.** Each paid fill carries the copay the member's PrairieRx plan sets for the drug's formulary status, once per fill, and nothing on a fill whose drug belongs to an exempt drug class. An emergency supply and a transition fill carry no copay. The copay is never larger than the amount the plan paid on the fill; it counts toward the member's aggregate cost-sharing cap under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, and once that cap is reached, pharmacy fills in the same period carry no copay. A reversal returns exactly the copay of the fill it reverses.

### Which scheduled copay applies

| Formulary status of the fill | Scheduled copay used |
|---|---|
| Preferred generic | The plan's preferred generic copay |
| Preferred brand | The plan's preferred brand copay |
| Specialty | The plan's specialty copay |
| Covered over-the-counter drug | The plan's covered OTC copay |
| Any other status (a non-preferred drug approved by exception) | The plan's non-preferred copay |

### When the copay is nothing

- the fill's drug is in an exempt drug class of the plan;
- the fill is an emergency supply;
- the fill is a transition fill;
- the member's aggregate cost-sharing cap under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership has been reached for the period in which the fill falls.

### Amount charged

The copay on a fill is the lesser of the scheduled copay and the amount the plan paid on that fill, charged once for the fill.

### Worked examples (hypothetical amounts)

| Hypothetical fill | Scheduled copay | Amount the plan paid | Copay charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Preferred brand, no exemption | $4.00 | $38.20 | $4.00 |
| Covered OTC drug with a prescription | $0.50 | $0.35 | $0.35 |
| Naloxone (exempt class) | — | $41.00 | $0.00 |
| Transition fill | — | any | $0.00 |

*A fill carrying a $3.00 copay is later reversed.* The reversal returns $3.00 — exactly the copay of that fill, no more and no less.
